title.narrative: Call-off from framework agreement ISK audit of Rwanda Women's Network 2026 - Call-off from framework agreement ISK audit of Rwanda Women Network 2026
ISK-granskning från rangordnat ramavtal av Rwanda Women's Network 2026

description.narrative: Insatsen avser en extern granskning av den potentiella partnerorganisationen Rwanda Women's networks interna styrning och kontroll (ISK) under beredningen av ansökan om treårigt stöd. Granskningen genomförs av revisionsfirman Ernst & Young där fältbesök till organisationen i Rwanda ingår. Granskningen förväntas identifiera eventuella svagheter och lämna rekommendationer avseende förbättringar. Baserat på resultaten kan Sida komma att kräva att ODWaCE åtgärdar vissa svagheter innan ett eventuellt avtal kan undertecknas och/eller att åtgärder inkluderas som avtalsvillkor.

The assignment concerns an external review of the potential partner organisation Rwanda Women's Networks' internal control during the assessment of the organisation's application for a three-year support. The review is carried out by the auditing firm Ernst & Young, and includes a field visit to the organisation in Rwanda. This assignment aims at reviewing the system for internal control ofODWaCE. The review is expected to identify any possible weaknesses amd make recommendations for improvement. Based on the findings, Sida may require that ODWaCE addresses identified weaknesses prior to a potential agreement and/or add some of the measures as agreement conditions.
